chapter: Brown's Band in Chicago and New York
title: Larry Shields and Gus Miller swap jobs
summary: Bert Kelly's Sherman Hotel band hired Gus Miller while Larry Shields took his place in Brown's band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, uh, Larry Shields wasn't with you then?

Oh, yes. Larry was with us. Well, then what became of Gus? Uh, what became of Gus? In the meantime, Bert Kelly was playing over at the Sherman Hotel, which was across the street from the Lambs. And Bert Kelly wanted a clarinet player like Gussie Miller. So, Raymond Lopez got in touch with Larry Shields and sent for him. Of course, Kelly paid the expense and all. And they brought Larry Shields up there. I hate to say this, but it's true. Larry Shields couldn't cut it with the band because the band was reading. You mean the, uh, Sherman House? Sherman House was reading all music. Larry couldn't play music. Whose band was that? Uh, Bert Kelly.
No, no, no. Bert Kelly, a banjo player.

And they, at that time, they had skating in the, in the Sherman Hotel, in the cocktail, well, cocktail line. It was, uh, restaurant and cafe. And, uh, so Bert Kelly came over and told Raymond about it, expressed his dissatisfaction. Gussie was listening. Gussie said, well, he said, I'll tell you what I'll do. I'll take the job. And I guess the job paid twice as much money as we were getting. So, he said, was he a reader? Could he read? Gussie? Oh, yeah. Yeah. You remember I told you he was in a school orchestra when he was reading music?
So, Guss went in there and he swapped jobs, that's all. He just swapped Larry.
Was there all right feelings in the band?

No, no, no. It was agreed. Well, it, it, it, it was a thing to keep Larry Shields in Chicago. It keep from sending him back home. Mm-hmm. Because who could he play with? Mm-hmm. Except us. That was the only band he could play with. The rest of them all strictly Northmen.
Did he fit all right with you all?
